newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to raise state power rates by 8 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to raise state power rates by 8 pct - paper.

text.p: The Brazilian government is likely to allow its state power firms to raise electricity rates by 8.0 percent on average in coming days, O Globo newspaper said on Friday.
Citing an unnamed Finance Ministry source, the newspaper said the increase would be in line with recent rises authorised by the government to privatized power firms under their concession contracts.
Rio de Janeiro-based power distributor Light, privatized in May 1996, was the first to be allowed to raise its rates by 8.038 percent in November last year, the newspaper said.

Espirito Santo-based power utility Escelsa announced a 9.9 percent increase last December, while Rio de Janeiro-based Cerj, privatized in September 1996, raised its rates by 7.75 percent, O Globo said.
The latest rate adjustment for state power firms took place in 1996.
